Job Position: Verification Agent

Job Location: Nigerian Schools (All 36 States &amp; FCT)
Employment Type: Contract
Engagement Type: Flexible / Assignment-Based

Job Summary


	As the Verification Agent, you will support educational certificate verification by liaising with universities, polytechnics, and other tertiary institutions to confirm the authenticity of academic qualifications.
	This opportunity is open to students, institutional staff, and other individuals who can facilitate verification activities within their respective institutions or locations.


Responsibilities


	Liaise with universities, polytechnics, and other tertiary institutions to facilitate academic certificate verification
	Engage relevant institutional departments to confirm the authenticity of academic qualifications and records
	Conduct physical follow ups where necessary to ensure timely completion of verification requests
	Provide accurate verification feedback, supporting documentation, and timely updates on assigned requests
	Maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and accuracy throughout the verification process


Requirements


	Open to students, institutional staff, graduates, and other individuals with access to tertiary institutions across Nigeria.
	Good knowledge of the administrative processes and relevant departments within universities, polytechnics, or other tertiary institutions.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills with the ability to engage institutional representatives professionally.
	Ability to provide accurate information, follow instructions, and complete assigned verification requests within agreed timelines.
	Must be available to facilitate verification within their institution or location, either on a one-off or recurring assignment basis.


Remuneration
Commission Based.",

Job Position: Marketing Executive

	Managing Banex Mall Limited is seeking a creative, proactive and results-driven Marketing Executive to support the company&#39;s marketing activities, promote its facilities and services, attract customers and generate business opportunities.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for executing marketing campaigns, managing digital content, supporting event activations, engaging prospective clients and contributing to increased mall visibility, footfall and revenue.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the mall, its tenants, facilities and services.
	Create and manage content for social media platforms and other marketing channels.
	Design promotional materials, flyers, adverts and other marketing content.
	Support the marketing and promotion of event halls, available commercial spaces and mall activations.

	Support lead generation and follow-up activities to convert prospects into customers.
	Coordinate promotional activities, exhibitions, events and other mall marketing initiatives.

	Monitor market trends and competitors to identify new marketing opportunities.
	Support advertising, sponsorship and promotional partnerships.
	Track marketing campaign performance, customer engagement and leads generated.
	Prepare regular reports on marketing activities, campaign results and business opportunities.
	Work closely with the Sales, Leasing, Events and Operations teams to achieve the company&#39;s commercial objectives.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed based on:


	Marketing campaigns executed.
	Growth in social media engagement and brand visibility.
	Qualified leads generated.

	Timeliness and quality of marketing reports.

	Basic graphic design skills, preferably using Canva or similar applications.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong interpersonal, organisational and presentation skills.
	Ability to generate ideas, execute campaigns and meet deadlines.

Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;

The company oversees the day-to-day management of the mall, ensuring a safe, clean, and conducive environment for businesses, customers, and visitors.

Its core functions include facility management, tenant relations, commercial and leasing, sales, security coordination, maintenance of common areas, revenue administration, compliance monitoring, customer service, and the overall enhancement of the mall's commercial operations. The company is committed to maintaining high operational standards, maximizing tenant satisfaction, and supporting a thriving business environment within the mall.

Job Summary


	We are seeking a skilled and experienced Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot the organization’s network infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient connectivity.


Key Responsibilities


	Design, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and network infrastructure.
	Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues.
	Configure and manage routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices.
	Implement network security measures and ensure compliance with IT policies.
	Perform network upgrades, backups, and routine maintenance.
	Document network configurations and resolve technical incidents promptly.
	Collaborate with IT teams to support business and infrastructure requirements.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
	3+ years of experience in network engineering or administration.
	Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
	Experience with Cisco, MikroTik, Fortinet, or similar networking technologies.
	Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
	Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent will be an advantage.
